identity_and_content_findings.finding: Exact intended title and 2009 regulation No.7, TRAI issuer, F.No.305-25/2008-QoS and own date 20 March 2009. Current official Main Regulation row is dated 20/03/2009. Listing date 23 March 2009 is preserved separately and not adopted as own date; commencement 1 July 2009 is also not own date.

Complete regulations include definitions/licensed-provider scope, wireline and mobile network/customer benchmarks, coverage tests, consumer surveys, recordkeeping, reports, publication, review and interpretation. R.K.Arnold, Secretary, signs on p13. Repeal of 2005 QoS regulations with savings is not a withdrawal of this 2009 instrument.

Complete memorandum background and consultation; provision/fault/repair measures, grade of service, CCR/ASR, billing and complaint methodology, closures, call-centre access, refunds and BTS availability. Historical consultations and prior directions are identified as context, not separate notices.

BTS downtime and force-majeure exclusion, CSSR/SDCCH/TCH congestion, dropped-call and worst-cell measures, voice quality, street/in-vehicle coverage, POI congestion, pre/postpaid billing and resolution/credit methodology all read, including formulas and stakeholder discussion.

Call-centre response, 7-day closure, deposit refund within 60 days with delay interest; customer perception dimensions and satisfaction scores; quarterly PMR/monthly POI reporting; no internal audit scheme then prescribed; authority audit/report powers; operator website publication; benchmarking and possible future financial-disincentive regulations. P54 completes the explanatory memorandum, not a missing continuation.

Original official issuer version marked TO BE PUBLISHED IN THE GAZETTE OF INDIA, not Gazette facsimile. No later 2012-2019 amendments or consolidated CA_20032009.pdf silently substituted. No promised substantive schedule/annexure absent in the acquired version.
